G20 Atlanta Talks Conclude Amidst Disagreements on Key Issues

G20 foreign ministers concluded their talks in Atlanta without reaching consensus on critical issues. During the meeting, US Senator Marco Rubio issued a warning regarding attacks in the Red Sea attributed to Iran. Reports also indicated that the Western bloc decided to halt a traditional family photo session.
